say:4:1029709001:0.text: Phew... I thought I was ready for this, but this wind and sand? It's on a whole other level.
say:4:1029709001:0.source_cn: 天啊，这里的风沙……我做过心理准备了，还是没想到这么厉害。

say:5:1029709002:0.text: The wind whips up the sand like iron lashes hitting your face—*cough cough*—ptooey!
say:5:1029709002:0.source_cn: 风卷着沙子，就像铁鞭一样往人脸上抽——咳咳咳，呸呸！

say:7:1029709003:0.text: Not on purpose! Open your mouth for one second out here and bam! Instant sand buffet.
say:7:1029709003:0.source_cn: 是，一张嘴就会飞进来，而且这附近太干燥了。

say:9:1029709004:0.text: Even Bradduck looks all shriveled up...
say:9:1029709004:0.source_cn: 连布拉达克一世好像都蔫了……

say:11:1029709005:0.text: The wind's still strong. The caravan behind us is having trouble moving forward too.
say:11:1029709005:0.source_cn: 风还是很强，刚刚看了下，后面的商队好像也走不动了。
